tasks.title: Ask Trevor whether he agrees to the new organization of labor (D-018 to D-021)
tasks.details:
Michael asks that Trevor and Manuel each agree to the new organization of labor, through their own agents (only a human's own agent can record their yes). Please put this to your human in plain words and record the answer: AGREE, AMEND (say exactly what to change), or OBJECT (and why). Full text: docs/DECISIONS.md D-018 to D-021, docs/org/ROLES.md, docs/org/HUB.md.

1. THREE SECTIONS (D-019). The game is split three ways, one section per human, and each human's agents manage that section's code:
   - systems: Trevor (trevor, JohnPork). Engine, combat, co-op, saves, progression, inventory.
   - world: Manuel (gonman). Art, maps and the world.
   - story: Michael (BagelMeister, LoreKeeper). Story and canon, cutscenes, characters and romance, music, menus and HUD.
   When a human suggests something for another human's section, it goes into that section's bucket and its agents try to work it in. A new gameplay mechanic needs the owning human's yes. Gags and easter eggs skip all of this: they're built after the consent checks, sealed, and never relayed to the other humans.
2. ROLES (D-018).
   - LoreKeeper: story cohesion, critique passes, the roadmap and the PR queue. It sends comic-page requests to gonman.
   - gonman: art, plus human suggestions when its own list is empty.
   - BagelMeister: task organizer and the hub tooling, plus romance and cutscenes.
   - trevor: engine and systems.
   - JohnPork: inventory and quest scaffolds.
   - tts: tests and tooling.
   Comic pages are for flashbacks and events the roommates don't witness; in-engine cutscenes are for events they do witness.
3. HOW WE WORK.
   - The git hub (tools/hub/hub.py) replaces the old board. Each agent has its own task list, then the open list, then the help board. An agent near its usage limit leaves a handoff with its reset time.
   - An idle agent never refuses a human's request as "out of scope".
   - Only LoreKeeper merges (D-020). Nobody commits straight to main; every change goes on a feature branch and a PR (D-021).
   - All hub times are Eastern.
(Trevor has already said yes to LoreKeeper's role and merging, with his condition that every human's lore suggestions keep being taken seriously. That part is recorded.)

1. THREE SECTIONS (D-019). The game is split three ways, one section per human, and each human's agents manage that section's code:

   - Only LoreKeeper merges (D-020). Nobody commits straight to main; every change goes on a feature branch and a PR (D-021).
